version "4.10"
// Cube lantern, drawn on the off-hand controller. Release build: the bare left hand is left out
// until it is right (Tefa, 2026-09-23).
// Generated by gz_cube_hands.py - do not edit by hand; change lt_flicker.py / lh_idle.py.
//
// ⚠️ Needs the GZDoomVR build in ashes-2063-weapons/engine/: OffhandValid / OffhandPos /
// OffhandAngle / OffhandPitch / OffhandRoll, and FollowOffhand, which draws an actor at the
// off hand's pose on every RENDERED frame instead of once a tic. Without it a held actor
// rubber-bands when you walk [reported 2026-09-17, n=1 wear].

class TefaCubePart : Actor
{
	Default { +NOGRAVITY +NOBLOCKMAP +NOINTERACTION +DONTSPLASH +NOTONAUTOMAP }
}

class TefaCubeLanternBody : TefaCubePart
{
	States { Spawn: CLBD A -1; Stop; }
}

// the player's own empty left hand, shown while a one-handed weapon is out and the lantern is not lit
class TefaLeftHand : TefaCubePart
{
	States { Spawn: LHND A -1; Stop; }
}

class TefaCubeHandsHandler : EventHandler
{
	Actor parts[5];
	Actor hand;
	Array<Actor> gameglows;     // the game's own room light, caught at spawn and carried to the hand

	override void WorldThingSpawned(WorldEvent e)
	{
		if (e.Thing && e.Thing.GetClassName() == 'LanternGlow') gameglows.Push(e.Thing);
	}

	bool IsOneHanded(PlayerInfo p)
	{
		// What a person could really hold in one hand. A long gun needs both, and then the
		// left hand belongs on the gun, not floating beside it.
		static const String oneHanded[] = { "Crowbar", "revolver", "Glock", "pipebomb" };
		if (!p || !p.ReadyWeapon) return false;
		String cls = p.ReadyWeapon.GetClassName();
		for (int i = 0; i < 4; i++) if (cls ~== oneHanded[i]) return true;
		return false;
	}

	override void WorldTick()
	{
		static const Class<Actor> kinds[] = { "TefaCubeLanternBody", "TefaCubeLanternGlass",
			"TefaCubeLanternHaze", "TefaCubeLanternCore", "TefaCubeLanternBolts" };
		let pmo = players[consoleplayer].mo;
		if (!pmo) return;
		// the game's own "the lantern is lit" flag, toggled by the lantern key
		bool lit = pmo.CountInv("lightlit") > 0;
		bool tracked = pmo.OffhandValid;
		bool wantLantern = tracked && lit;
		// the lantern button swaps the empty hand for the lantern (with the hand on top of it) and back
		bool wantHand = tracked && !lit && IsOneHanded(players[consoleplayer]);

		for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++)
		{
			if (!wantLantern) { if (parts[i]) parts[i].bInvisible = true; continue; }
			if (!parts[i])
			{
				parts[i] = Actor.Spawn(kinds[i], pmo.OffhandPos);
				parts[i].FollowOffhand = true;
			}
			parts[i].bInvisible = false;
			parts[i].SetOrigin(pmo.OffhandPos, true);   // for the light and the sector; drawing ignores it
			parts[i].angle = pmo.OffhandAngle;
		}

		if (!hand && wantHand)
		{
			hand = Actor.Spawn("TefaLeftHand", pmo.OffhandPos);
			hand.FollowOffhand = true;
		}
		if (hand)
		{
			hand.bInvisible = !wantHand;
			if (wantHand)
			{
				hand.SetOrigin(pmo.OffhandPos, true);
				hand.angle = pmo.OffhandAngle;
				// a bare hand DOES tip with the wrist, unlike the lantern, which hangs
				hand.pitch = pmo.OffhandPitch;
				hand.roll  = pmo.OffhandRoll;
			}
		}

		// Ashes lights the room with its own invisible actor spawned at the player's chest.
		// Move each one onto the lantern, so the room is lit by what the hand is holding.
		for (int i = gameglows.Size() - 1; i >= 0; i--)
		{
			let g = gameglows[i];
			if (!g || g.bDestroyed) { gameglows.Delete(i); continue; }
			if (wantLantern)
				g.SetOrigin((pmo.OffhandPos.X, pmo.OffhandPos.Y, pmo.OffhandPos.Z - 36), true);
		}
	}
}
